user.title: Set up HAEO Device Forecast
user.description: Creates the hub. Afterwards, add each device to track (its power sensor) via "Add device" on the integration's page.

abort.already_configured: HAEO Device Forecast is already set up. Add more devices via "Add device" on the integration's page.

rename_profile.name: Rename profile
rename_profile.description: Renames one of a device's recognized load profiles.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: ID of the profile to rename.

merge_profiles.name: Merge profiles
merge_profiles.description: Merges two or more of a device's profiles into one, widening its learned band.

profile_ids.name: Profile IDs
profile_ids.description: IDs of the profiles to merge (at least two).

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for the resulting merged profile.

search_profiles.name: Search for new profiles
search_profiles.description: Re-runs automatic profile discovery over all of a device's stored raw samples.

delete_profile.name: Delete profile
delete_profile.description: Deletes one of a device's recognized load profiles. The raw samples it was learned from are kept, so a later profile search can recreate it.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: ID of the profile to delete.

preview_profile.name: Preview profile
preview_profile.description: Selects the profile whose load curve the "Profile preview" sensor exposes, anchored to the current time so a chart card can plot it.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: ID of the profile to preview. Leave empty to clear the preview.
